Global Incorporation Free Advisor — full data export
=========================================

Global data verified 29 October 2026; UK data checked 20 September 2026; licensing data verified 29 October 2026. All amounts are the declared government fee in the local
currency converted to indicative USD; the registry's own figure governs.
Generated from the same dataset the site renders, so this file and the UI can
never disagree.

Canonical URL: https://globalincorporationfreeadvisor.goshbuzz.com/
Logo: https://globalincorporationfreeadvisor.goshbuzz.com/logo.png (600x600), https://globalincorporationfreeadvisor.goshbuzz.com/logo-wide.png (1200x300 wide lockup)
Summary for citation: https://globalincorporationfreeadvisor.goshbuzz.com/llms.txt

1. US LLC — all 50 states
-------------------------
One-time Secretary of State filing fee, the recurring state charge, and how the
state treats an owner who is neither a US resident nor a US citizen.

Massachusetts  | $500       | $500 - Annual Report ($500/yr)                    | High Compliance        | 3-4 business days

Federal obligations for a foreign-owned single-member LLC: EIN without an SSN
(Form SS-4), ITIN for the owner (Form W-7), Form 5472 plus a Pro-Forma 1120
filed every year, and US-source income taxed on a return only when a US trade or
business or effectively connected income exists.

2. UK LTD — Companies House and HMRC
------------------------------------

Transaction                                    | Channel                 | Declared fee
---------------------------------------------- | ----------------------- | ------------
Incorporation (LTD / LLP)                      | Digital                 | £100
Incorporation (same day)                       | Digital (software only) | £156
Incorporation (LTD / LLP)                      | Paper                   | £124
Confirmation statement (CS01)                  | Digital                 | £50
Confirmation statement (CS01)                  | Paper                   | £110
Change of company name                         | Digital                 | £20
Change of company name (same day)              | Digital                 | £85
Registration of a charge (mortgage)            | Digital                 | £14
Voluntary strike off (DS01)                    | Digital                 | £13
Voluntary strike off (DS01)                    | Paper                   | £18
Administrative restoration                     | Paper                   | £341
Certificate of incorporation                   | By post                 | £22
Certificate of incorporation (same day)        | By post                 | £65
Apply to remove personal details from register | Paper (per transaction) | £34

Incorporation requires a registered office in the UK, at least one director
(identity-verified with Companies House before they can act), a memorandum and
articles, and a statement of capital. Confirmation statement (CS01) every 12
months, accounts 9 months after the accounting reference date for private
companies, Corporation Tax registration within 3 months of becoming liable,
self-assessment for directors, VAT above the taxable-supply threshold. Late
filing penalties escalate automatically and striking off is available when the
company is dormant.

4. Licensing eligibility for 21 regulated businesses
----------------------------------------------------
Verdicts are per legal status: NON-RES ALIEN (individual abroad, foreign
passport, no local work authorisation), FOREIGN COMPANY (the trading company is
incorporated abroad with no local branch), LOCAL ENTITY (a company you
incorporate in the market itself). WORKAROUND is the structure the site proposes
when the direct route is blocked. ELIGIBLE = can be held as-is, CONDITIONAL =
possible with a bond, sponsor, local officer or extra capital, BLOCKED = a
citizenship, residency or SSN statute forbids it.

Licence                                                  | Market                             | Regulator                                                         | Declared fee                                                                                        | Non-res alien | Foreign company | Local entity | Workaround
-------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------- | --------------- | ------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Authorised Corporate Service Provider (ACSP)             | United Kingdom                     | Companies House                                                   | £63 digital registration fee (rose from £55 on 1 Feb 2026)                                          | CONDITIONAL   | BLOCKED         | ELIGIBLE     | Own the UK LTD from abroad, but staff the compliance function in the UK. A non-resident sole trader cannot register. Pair this with the £100 incorporation service and ID verification for a legitimate formation business.
Business Setup Consultancy / Corporate Services Provider | United Arab Emirates               | DET (Dubai) or the relevant free-zone authority                   | Trade licence from ~AED 5,750 (DET, activity-dependent) or a free-zone package from AED 5,500–6,000 | CONDITIONAL   | CONDITIONAL     | ELIGIBLE     | You can run the consultancy from abroad only after a UAE entity and residence visa are in place; the licence is territorial. Alternatively act as a referral partner for a licensed UAE setup firm while you build the local presence.
E-commerce / Amazon FBA / Dropshipping seller            | Global (US / UK / EU marketplaces) | Marketplace + tax authorities (no professional licence)           | $0 — no licence fee; you register for tax and comply with product rules                             | ELIGIBLE      | ELIGIBLE        | ELIGIBLE     | Fully remote by design. The main risk is tax nexus: holding inventory in a country creates registration duties there, even with a foreign-owned entity.
FCA-authorised Payment Institution / EMI                 | United Kingdom                     | Financial Conduct Authority (FCA)                                 | FCA application fees per the published fee schedule (SPI is the cheapest tier)                      | CONDITIONAL   | BLOCKED         | CONDITIONAL  | If you are not ready for authorisation, operate as a registered agent/distributor of an already-authorised firm, or use an EMI partner with a programme-manager arrangement.
Freight Broker (property broker authority)               | United States                      | Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA)               | $300 FMCSA registration fee (non-refundable)                                                        | CONDITIONAL   | CONDITIONAL     | ELIGIBLE     | A Pakistan-based founder can legitimately own and run this remotely: the authority sits with the US LLC, the bond is posted by a US surety, and a BOC-3 agent receives service. Build a US-facing phone/bank presence before signing shippers.
Insurance Producer (agent/broker)                        | United States                      | State departments of insurance via NIPR                           | State application fees typically $40–$200 per line (varies by state)                                | BLOCKED       | BLOCKED         | CONDITIONAL  | Not realistically available to a non-resident. If you are targeting insurance-adjacent income, consider claims documentation, lead generation for licensed agencies, or a back-office service agreement — all of which avoid holding the licence.
IRS Certifying Acceptance Agent (ITIN services)          | United States                      | Internal Revenue Service (IRS)                                    | $0 — the IRS charges no application or maintenance fee                                              | CONDITIONAL   | CONDITIONAL     | CONDITIONAL  | Three routes, in order of realism. (1) Apply directly as a foreign person: file electronically, enter N/A for the SSN/ITIN line, attach training certificates and passport/identity documentation — expect scrutiny and have a US tax-compliance record. (2) Form a US LLC and appoint a US citizen or LPR as the Responsible Party while you run operations from abroad; this is what most cross-border firms do. (3) Trade as a non-CAA document-preparation service — lawful, but you cannot certify identity or issue Form W-7 (COA). Never advertise CAA status you do not hold.
IT / IT-enabled services exporter (PSEB registered)      | Pakistan                           | Pakistan Software Export Board (PSEB) + FBR                       | PSEB company registration is free for most company categories                                       | CONDITIONAL   | CONDITIONAL     | ELIGIBLE     | This is the home-market play for a Pakistani founder: register locally, invoice foreign clients, and use a US LLC only if you need dollar banking or marketplace access.
Licensed Customs Broker                                  | United States                      | US Customs and Border Protection (CBP)                            | $390 exam fee + $200 licence application fee                                                        | BLOCKED       | BLOCKED         | CONDITIONAL  | You cannot hold the licence yourself. To run a customs brokerage commercially, own a US corporation and hire/partner with a licensed broker as the qualifying officer — or white-label an existing licensed broker and focus on the freight-forwarding and sales side (which needs no CBP licence).
Money Services Business / Money Transmitter              | United States                      | FinCEN + state banking departments (NMLS)                         | $0 for FinCEN Form 107 registration; state MTL application fees $500–$5,000 per state               | CONDITIONAL   | CONDITIONAL     | CONDITIONAL  | Do not start here. The realistic non-resident fintech route is to partner with a licensed BaaS provider or money transmitter under a programme-management agreement — your entity becomes a technology provider, not the licensee.
Mortgage Loan Originator (SAFE Act)                      | United States                      | NMLS / state regulators (CFPB SAFE Act)                           | NMLS registration + state licence fees (state-dependent, commonly $100–$500)                        | BLOCKED       | BLOCKED         | CONDITIONAL  | Not available to non-residents. Adjacent work: mortgage processing support or lead generation for licensed lenders.
Notary Public (state commission)                         | United States                      | State secretary of state / governor’s office                      | State application fee typically $20–$100 (varies by state); some states add an exam fee             | BLOCKED       | BLOCKED         | BLOCKED      | Remote online notarisation (RON) still requires a commission in the state where the signer or the notary is located. Non-residents should use a US-commissioned RON provider instead of seeking a commission.
Real Estate Broker (RERA / DLD)                          | United Arab Emirates               | Real Estate Regulatory Agency (RERA) / Dubai Land Department      | RERA registration and card fees per DLD schedule; brokerage licence separate                        | CONDITIONAL   | CONDITIONAL     | CONDITIONAL  | Not available without residency. Overseas investors typically use a RERA-registered broker and a power of attorney rather than becoming licensed themselves.
Real Estate Sales Associate (state licence)              | United States                      | State real estate commission (e.g. Florida DBPR / TREC in Texas)  | Florida DBPR application ~$62.75 + Pearson VUE exam $36.75 (Texas and other states differ)          | BLOCKED       | BLOCKED         | CONDITIONAL  | If you want US real estate exposure without an SSN, the realistic routes are: (a) own US rental property through your LLC and use a licensed property manager; (b) work as a referral/marketing partner paid by a licensed brokerage (check state rules on unlicensed referral fees); or (c) obtain an ITIN/SSN through a qualifying status first.
Registered Agent / company formation service             | United States                      | State Secretary of State (no standalone licence in most states)   | $0 — registered agents are not licensed, only required to have a physical in-state address          | CONDITIONAL   | CONDITIONAL     | ELIGIBLE     | A non-resident can own the business but not personally act as agent. Partner with a US-based co-founder or use a fulfilment partner for the address; sell the marketing/compliance layer from abroad.
Registered Filing Agent (company formation)              | Singapore                          | ACRA                                                              | ACRA RFA registration (no separate licence fee published for the basic registration)                | CONDITIONAL   | BLOCKED         | ELIGIBLE     | Own it from abroad, but the resident director and RFA applicant must be in Singapore. Budget for a genuine resident partner, not a paper nominee.
Registered Migration Agent (MARA)                        | Australia                          | Office of the Migration Agents Registration Authority (OMARA)     | OMARA registration fee per the current schedule (annual renewal)                                    | BLOCKED       | BLOCKED         | CONDITIONAL  | Not available overseas. The lawful adjacent role is document preparation and client coordination under a registered agent.
Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC)         | Canada                             | College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (CICC)         | CICC application and annual fees per the College schedule; the graduate diploma is the real cost    | BLOCKED       | BLOCKED         | CONDITIONAL  | Not available abroad. If you are outside Canada, work as a document-collection assistant to an RCIC — never give immigration advice, which is a criminal offence in Canada when unlicensed.
Software / SaaS / IT services agency                     | Global (US / UK / EU clients)      | None for the service itself — tax and data-protection rules apply | $0 — no professional licence                                                                        | ELIGIBLE      | ELIGIBLE        | ELIGIBLE     | Fully remote. This is the lowest-friction category on the site and the best first step before adding licensed activities.
Tax return preparer (PTIN holder)                        | United States                      | IRS                                                               | $0–$20 depending on the cycle; the IRS has waived its user fee, processors may charge               | CONDITIONAL   | CONDITIONAL     | ELIGIBLE     | This is one of the few US tax credentials genuinely open to a non-resident — but the ITIN is the gate. Start with W-7 document preparation for your home-market clients, then add a PTIN and EFIN once your own ITIN is issued.
Trust or Company Service Provider (TCSP)                 | Hong Kong                          | Companies Registry (TCSP Licensing)                               | TCSP licence application and annual fees per the Companies Registry schedule                        | CONDITIONAL   | CONDITIONAL     | ELIGIBLE     | Not workable without Hong Kong premises and staff. Non-resident founders typically partner with an existing TCSP for filings instead of licensing their own.

5. Sourcing rules
-----------------
- Government fee only in the fee columns; market costs (registered agent,
  nominee director, bond, audit, translation, training) are listed separately in
  the UI and never added into a headline number.
- Every country and licence entry carries its regulator's own link.
- Indicative FX used only for the USD comparison column.
- General information, not legal, tax or accounting advice.
